name: ISO 80369-7 & 20 Medical Connector Navigation System
description: Interactive React SPA for clause search, DVP generation, and connector inspection — plus static HTML slides for ISO 80369-7 & ISO 80369-20 medical small-bore connector standards.
majorCapabilities: Bilingual (zh/en) clause explorer with real-time filtering
DVP (Design Verification Plan) test matrix generator with Excel export
Connector inspector with ISO standard figure renderer
Clause comparison matrix with L1/L2 type filtering
Topic-to-clause visual map for rapid standard navigation
Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline cache
Static presentation slides (public/slides/) for educational use
